name: South Luzon Championship 2023

venue.name: Robinsons Dasmariñas
venue.address: Emilio Aguinaldo Highway, corner Governor's Dr, Sitio Palapala, Dasmariñas

information:
The registration fee for this competition will be Php 350.00 inclusive of 2 events of your choice. Additional Php 50 will be added on top of the base registration for each event you want to add.

Events can be edited after registering. Additional fees will be collected on-site in case the competitor adds an event. The registration fee is non-refundable, including when deleting an event.

Kindly check the [Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthLuzonChampionship2023#30577-payment-details) tab on how to pay for the registration fee.
